segments.sn3.6:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn3.6:1.3: “idha mayhaṃ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.sn3.6:1.4: ‘appakā te sattā lokasmiṃ ye uḷāre uḷāre bhoge labhitvā na ceva majjanti, na ca pamajjanti, na ca kāmesu gedhaṃ āpajjanti, na ca sattesu vippaṭipajjanti.
segments.sn3.6:1.5: Atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā lokasmiṃ ye uḷāre uḷāre bhoge labhitvā majjanti ceva pamajjanti, ca kāmesu ca gedhaṃ āpajjanti, sattesu ca vippaṭipajjantī’”ti.
segments.sn3.6:2.2: Appakā te, mahārāja, sattā lokasmiṃ, ye uḷāre uḷāre bhoge labhitvā na ceva majjanti, na ca pamajjanti, na ca kāmesu gedhaṃ āpajjanti, na ca sattesu vippaṭipajjanti.
segments.sn3.6:2.3: Atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā lokasmiṃ, ye uḷāre uḷāre bhoge labhitvā majjanti ceva pamajjanti ca kāmesu ca gedhaṃ āpajjanti, sattesu ca vippaṭipajjantī”ti.
segments.sn3.6:3.3: Atisāraṃ na bujjhanti, migā kūṭaṃva oḍḍitaṃ;
segments.sn3.6:3.5: Pacchāsaṃ kaṭukaṃ hoti, vipāko hissa pāpako”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe uḷāre uḷāreti paṇīte ca bahuke ca.
Uḷārasaddo seṭṭhe bahuke ca dissatīti āha “paṇīte ca bahuke cā”ti.
